### Overall Assessment

The black-sails:reviewer (Captain Flint) delivered a strong, character-driven review that identified all 6 critical SQL injection vulnerabilities and the PCI-DSS violation for stored credit cards. The review also found several valid novel issues (missing transactions, unclosed response bodies, bounds checking). Key gaps include missing the CSV credit card exposure, authorization checks on BulkUpdatePrices and ExportOrders, cache read mutex issues, unclosed database rows, and low-priority items. The persona was exceptionally well-executed with pirate fury and maritime metaphors, though the aggressive tone sacrificed some professionalism points.
